messages:
Alex (SRE): Quick planning question — Q2 roadmap sequencing: prioritize p99 latency SLO work vs Feature Catalyst (customer revenue). Need a short proposal by EOD. Thoughts? :thinking:
Maria - Eng: Quick context — Feature Catalyst is a large customer ask, medium engineering effort (maybe 2 sprints), high revenue impact if shipped this quarter.
Lina (Infra): From infra: the p99 reduction is ~3–5% latency improvement across tail cases, estimated 3 sprints with some infra refactors. Also removes a recurring toil item (nightly cache rebuilds).
Jay (PM): For prioritization, can we RICE both quickly? I care about customer unblock + launch timing.
Maria - Eng: Rough RICE (back of napkin): Feature Catalyst: Reach=0.25 (major customer), Impact=8, Confidence=6, Effort=20 -> RICE ~ (0.25*8*6)/20 = 0.6
Maria - Eng: SLO project: Reach=1 (all users), Impact=6, Confidence=7, Effort=30 -> RICE ~ (1*6*7)/30 = 1.4
Lina (Infra): Interesting — RICE favors the SLO work because it benefits everyone and reduces toil. But revenue urgency for Catalyst is real.
Jay (PM): If RICE says SLO first, can we do a sequencing compromise? e.g., ship a minimal Feature Catalyst MVP behind a feature flag while SLO work lands. :thinking:
Alex (SRE): That seems reasonable. Also we should define launch criteria for Catalyst that are SRE-friendly:
Alex (SRE): ```
- Canary for 5% of traffic for 48h with no p99 regression > 10%
- Error rate delta <= 0.05%
- Perf dashboard added + alert on 2x baseline
- Post-launch runbook + rollback plan
```
Maria - Eng: Agree. We can scope Catalyst MVP to remove heavy batch job and provide a stubbed analytics view — cuts effort in half.
Lina (Infra): If we reduce Catalyst scope, it becomes 1 sprint + canary => acceptable to do in parallel with SLO work. We can dedicate one infra engineer to SLO core and one to the flagging/rollout pipeline.
Jay (PM): OK — proposal: Start SLO refactor (3-sprint project) as priority. Parallel: small scoped Catalyst MVP (1 sprint) behind flag + canary. Re-evaluate after SLO first milestone.
Alex (SRE): Sounds good. Add acceptance SLO gates to the roadmap item: p99 target improvement >= 15% from baseline or incident rate reduction >= 20% within 30 days post-deploy.
Maria - Eng: I'll update the ticket and add the RICE numbers + new MVP scope.
Alex (SRE): Also let's track toil burndown as a metric (hours saved per week) so we can show operational ROI. Lina, can you add an estimate to the infra ticket?
Lina (Infra): On it. I'll post the rough ETA and updated runbook by tomorrow.
deploy-bot: Deployed branch alex/slo-proposal to staging at 11:02am — smoke tests passed. :rocket:
Jay (PM): Great. Thanks everyone — I'll put this plan in the roadmap doc and ping execs for visibility. :thumbsup:
